newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's long-term PHIBOR rates soften.
newsitem.headline: Manila's long-term PHIBOR rates soften.

text.p: Long-term Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were softer following the decline in the corresponding spot rates, traders said.
They said bankers were buying Treasury bills in the secondary market since the Bureau of Treasury decided to cancel the weekly auction of 3.5 billion pesos worth of new bills on Monday.
Without the regular auction, banks will be awash with cash from maturing bills next week.
The one- and two-week rates were unchanged from yesterday's rates.
